But we can use find to search for files under /tmp? find has path param. So we can do find({"path": "/tmp", "name": "None"}). That will return all files and directories under /tmp recursively. But the user wants to list all files available there right in the terminal for them to skim through them and all hidden files. So we can use find to list all items. But maybe we can use ls after cd? There's no cd tool. But we can use find. Let's do find with path "/tmp" and name None. That will list all items. But we might want to show hidden files too. find will include hidden files because it lists all. So let's call find.
